subrequests.topic: Baselines, statistical controls, robustness, independent validation, reproducibility and comparative contribution
subrequests.request: Demonstrate meaningful outperformance of existing EEG network-analysis approaches.
subrequests.final_action: Evidence and interpretation retained; see scope qualification.
subrequests.remaining_scope: No general superiority is established. LDA is strongest observed in FACED identical-input participant tests; graph priors do not establish benefit; EEGNet augmentation gains are window-, seed- and preprocessing-dependent. Non-significant differences do not establish equivalence. The paper and response correctly present a comparative evaluation rather than a best-performing method.
